mission: BanG Dream North America Chinese Community (北美炸梦同好会 / バンドリ北米華人コミュニティ) is a North America-based fan community for BanG Dream! and its bands. We organize meetups, share concert info, and welcome new fans across LA, NYC, SF, Seattle, Toronto, and beyond.
history: Founded in 2024 by fans across LA, NYC, SF, Seattle, and Toronto. Started as a Discord group, grew into local cover bands and event meetups. The tri-lingual name reflects our core membership — Chinese-speaking BanG Dream fans living in North America who connect across English, Chinese, and Japanese.

faq.a: Click the Discord button anywhere on the site to join our Discord server.

faq.q: Do I need to speak Chinese or Japanese?
faq.a: No — English, Chinese (中文), and Japanese (日本語) are all welcome. Most channels run in Chinese and English; Japanese is welcome too.
Informal city groups exist within Discord. Check the #regions channels for LA, NYC, SF, Seattle, Toronto, and more.

faq.q: Can I bring my cover band?
faq.a: Yes! Cover bands are a core part of the community. Reach out in #cover-bands on Discord.

coc: Be respectful. No harassment, no doxxing, no NSFW content. English, Chinese, and Japanese all welcome — please be patient with translation. Idol/band-bashing toward other Bushiroad properties is not allowed. Concert spoilers should be tagged. Treat everyone the way you'd want to be treated at a concert.
joinInstructions:
1. Join Discord via the button anywhere on this site.

2. Read #rules and the Code of Conduct.

3. Introduce yourself in #intros — share your oshi band and your city.

4. Pick city / oshi / interest roles in #role-picker.

5. Watch #events for upcoming meetups in your area.
